title: Specs first: features/daw/automation.feature and its envelope steps
description:
## Intent

Write the M4 specs first and watch them fail.

## Steps

- `features/daw/automation.feature` from the M4 stories; steps in `features/daw/STEPS.md` and `crates/apricity-daw/tests/daw.rs` that read an envelope as (beat, value in the score's units) pairs and evaluate it at any beat.

## Verification

`CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2 safe-run.sh -- cargo test -p apricity-daw --test daw` runs the new scenarios; each fails for missing behavior.

## Release

`test(<this task's id>): specs for automation in DAW sets`, or folded into the first M4 feat commit.
